newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Egypt's Mubarak to meet Tunisian leader.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak to meet Tunisian leader.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak will travel from Libya to Tunisia on Tuesday for talks with Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali, a senior Tunisisan official said.
The Tunisian presidency's spokesman confirmed diplomatic reports of the one-day visit and said it was within the framework of the tradition of consultations between the two heads of states.
Mubarak spent Monday night in Tripoli where he held talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.
The talks in Tripoli focused on "international issues and particularly the latest developments in the Mediterranean region," JANA said on Tuesday.
It was not clear how Mubarak would travel from Tripoli to Tunisia.
A U.N. embargo bans air travel to or from Libya. The travel restrictions are aimed at forcing Libya to hand over two of its citizens wanted for the bombing of a Pan Am airliner over Scotland in 1988.

JANA said Libya and Egypt were coordinating their response to a recent announcement that European Union countries would set up a task force for intervention in the Mediterranean. Libya protested against the decision.
